📌 How to Read This Manual

Each module shows a real screenshot of your Hey-Leban app with numbered red callouts marking the exact buttons and fields to interact with. Follow the step-by-step instructions below each screenshot in the numbered order shown.

1

Staff Login

Enter your credentials to access the billing terminal

/login
① Enter Email
② Enter Password
③ Show / Hide
④ Click Login

Figure 1.1 — Staff Login Page at /login

1

Enter Email Address

Type your staff email in the Email Address field (e.g. staff@heyleban.com).

2

Enter Password

Type your account password in the Password field.

3

Toggle Password Visibility (Optional)

Click the Show button on the right of the password field to reveal what you've typed.

4

Click Login

Press the orange Login button. You will be taken directly to the POS billing screen.

💡 Tip: If you see "No network connection" — check your internet and try again. If credentials are wrong, verify your email with your manager.
2

Opening the Sales Shift

Set up the cash float and start today's billing session

/open-sales
⚠️ Important: You must open a sales session before you can take any orders or print bills. The POS shows "NO SESSION" in the header until you do this every shift.
① Session Status
② Enter Cash Amount
③ Quick Presets
④ Optional Note
⑤ Open Sales →
Cancel

Figure 2.1 — Open Sales Page at /open-sales

1

Check Session Status Banner

The red Session Closed banner confirms today's session hasn't started yet. This is expected at shift start.

2

Count Cash & Enter Opening Amount

Physically count your cash drawer float. Type the exact amount in the ₹ Opening Cash input field.

3

Use Quick Presets (Optional)

Tap ₹500, ₹1000, ₹1500, or ₹2000 preset buttons to quickly set the opening cash amount.

4

Add Opening Note (Optional)

Scroll down to Opening Note and add any remarks about the cash denominations or drawer state.

5

Click "Open Sales →"

Press the golden Open Sales → button at the bottom-right. You'll be redirected to the POS terminal immediately.

3

Taking Orders & POS Billing

Build cart, apply discounts, collect payment, print KOT & receipt

/pos
① Today's Date
② Search KOT
③ Search Order
④ Session Status
⑤ Close Sale
⑥ Orders
⑦ Search Products

⑩ Order Type
⑪ Cart Panel

Figure 3.1 — POS Terminal at /pos

1–3

Navigate & Search

Use the Search Products bar (⑦) or click Category Filter pills (⑧) to browse the menu.

2

Add Items to Cart

Tap any Product Card (⑨) to add it to the cart. Items with "Stock: 0" are greyed-out and unclickable.

3

Select Order Type

Choose Dine In, Delivery, or Takeout (⑩) at the top of the cart panel.

4

Apply Discount (Optional)

Click the Discount icon (⑫) to add a flat ₹ or % discount to the order total.

5

Print KOT for Kitchen

Click Print KOT (⑬) to send a Kitchen Order Ticket to the kitchen printer with all item names and quantities.

6

Collect Payment & Print Bill

Click Collect Payment (⑮) → choose Cash, UPI, or Card → confirm → click Print Bill (⑭) to print customer receipt.

4

Order Management & Cancellation

View, filter, manage, reprint, and cancel orders

/orders
① Orders Title
② Back to POS
③ Search & Filter Bar
④ Search Order No.
⑤ Filter by Status
⑥ Orders List — Click to Select
⑦ Order Details Panel

Figure 4.1 — Orders Management Page at /orders

1

Find Your Order

Type the Order Number in the Search Order No field (④), or use the Status dropdown (⑤) to filter by Pending, Completed, or Cancelled.

2

Select an Order

Click any order row in the Orders List (⑥). The right panel (⑦) will show full order details — items, totals, payment status.

3

Reprint KOT or Bill

In the detail panel (⑦), click Reprint KOT or Reprint Bill to print duplicate copies.

4

Cancel an Order

Click Cancel Order in the detail panel. A popup asks for a cancellation reason. Enter at least 3 characters and confirm.

🚫 Cancellation Rules:
1. If the order has recorded payments — you cannot cancel directly. Refund/void the payment first.
2. A cancellation reason of at least 3 characters is mandatory.
3. On cancel, all item stock is automatically restocked — no manual inventory update needed!
✅ Auto-Restock: When an order is cancelled, the system instantly returns all sold quantities back to inventory. Stock counts update in real-time on the POS screen.
Order Status What It Means Allowed Actions
PENDING Order placed, not yet fully paid Print KOT, Complete Payment, Cancel (if no payment)
COMPLETED Fully paid and closed Reprint Bill, View Details
CANCELLED Order void, stock returned View Details Only
5

Stock & Inventory Management

Add raw base materials, update stock, link products to ingredients

/settings/inventory
① Inventory Management
② Back
③ Raw Materials Tab
④ Products Tab
⑤ Search Bases
⑥ + New Base
⑦ Raw Material Cards

Figure 5.1 — Inventory / Stock Management at /settings/inventory

1

Select the Right Tab

Raw Materials tab (③) = bulk bases like Milk, Syrups, Flour shared across products.
Products tab (④) = standalone menu items tracked per unit.

2

Create a New Base / Raw Material

Click the dark + New Base button (⑥). Fill in the Name, Unit (kg, L, pcs), and set a Reorder Alert Level.

3

Update Stock (Add Received Stock)

Click Update Stock on any raw material card. Enter the new quantity received and an optional supplier note. Click Save.

4

Link Items to a Base (Recipe Linking)

Click the 🔗 Link Items button on a raw material card. Check which menu items use this ingredient. Save. When those items are sold, stock auto-deducts!

💡 How Auto-Deduction Works: Once you link Chocolate Shake to the Milk Base raw material, every time a cashier sells 1 Chocolate Shake on POS, the Milk Base count automatically decreases by 1. No manual tracking needed!
Stock Status Badge Color What to Do
In Stock Green No action needed, stock is healthy.
Low Stock Orange Stock is at or below reorder level — order more stock soon.
Out of Stock Red Item disabled on POS — add stock immediately to resume selling.
6

Settings, Reports & Closing Sales

Navigate business tools, manage menu, and close the daily shift

/settings
① Settings Page
② Logout Button
③ Business Reports
④ Sales Summary
⑤ Add Menu Items
⑥ Stock Management

Figure 6.1 — Settings Hub at /settings — Navigate to all management tools

1

Business Reports (③)

Click the Business Reports card to see daily revenue, payment method splits (Cash/UPI/Card), top-selling items, and date-range filters.

2

Sales Summary (④)

Click Summary to review order summaries by status — Open, Completed, Due, Cancelled — useful for shift handover verification.

3

Add Menu Items (⑤)

Click Manage Menu to add, edit or remove products, categories, prices, and tax rates on the menu.

4

Stock Management (⑥)

Click Add Stock to go directly to the Inventory Management page to update raw material and product stock quantities.

5

Close Sales Shift

From the POS screen, click the Close Sale button in the top-right navigation bar. This takes you to the shift closure page where you record expenses, verify cash, and generate the Z-Report.

💡 End-of-Day Closing Checklist:
1. Ensure all pending orders are completed or cancelled.
2. Record shift expenses: COGS, Salary, Rent, Utilities, Packaging, Miscellaneous.
3. Count physical cash in drawer and cross-check with expected cash total.
4. Add a closing note if there's a variance.
5. Click Close Session to lock the day's records and generate the Z-Report.
7

Business Report

Analyze daily revenue, profits, expenses, and top-selling products.

/business-report
① Key Metrics (Revenue, Profit)
② Profit & Loss Statement
③ Payment Methods (Cash/UPI)
④ Order Volume & Peak Hours
⑤ Top Selling Items

Figure 7.1 — Business Report at /business-report

1

Review Key Metrics

Check the top cards (①) for a quick glance at Gross Revenue, Collected Cash, Outstanding balances, and Net Profit.

2

Profit & Loss & Payments

The P&L Statement (②) subtracts COGS and operating expenses from revenue. The Payment Breakdown (③) shows how much was paid via Cash vs UPI vs Card.

3

Identify Peak Hours & Top Sellers

Use the Peak Hours chart (④) to see your busiest times, and the Top Sellers list (⑤) to track which products move the fastest.

8

Sales Summary

Detailed list of all orders processed during the shift.

/summary
① Total Order Counts
② Full Orders List Table

Figure 8.1 — Sales Summary at /summary

1

Order Status Breakdown

The top cards (①) summarize how many orders are Completed, Due (Unpaid), or Cancelled.

2

Review Individual Orders

The Orders Table (②) lists every transaction, showing the exact amount, order type (Dine-in vs Delivery), and Payment Status. This is crucial for verifying discrepancies before closing a shift.

9

Menu Management (Add Items)

Create menu categories and add products with prices.

/settings/items
① Categories Sidebar
② + New Category
③ + Add Item
④ Products inside selected category

Figure 9.1 — Menu Management at /settings/items

1

Manage Categories

Click + New Category (②) to create a section like "Hot Beverages". Select a category from the sidebar (①) to view its products.

2

Add a New Product

Click + Add Item (③). A form will appear where you can enter the product name, price, description, and assign it to a category.

Edit or Disable Items

In the products list (④), click the pencil icon to edit prices, or toggle the Active switch to instantly hide an item from the POS billing screen (useful when out of stock).

10

Change Password

Securely update your account credentials.

/change-password
Click to Update Password

Figure 10.1 — Change Password at /change-password

1

Enter Current Password

You must verify your identity by typing your existing password first.

2

Create New Password

Type a strong new password in both the New Password and Confirm New Password fields. They must match exactly.

3

Save Changes
